'''Lluma''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of grazing [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] that were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] and used as a staple [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] were interested in how lluma herds apparently followed the paths of tempests.

==Biology and appearance==
Lluma were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creatures [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. The large [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] had four long knobby [[Limb/Legends|legs]] with four-toed feet, a short tail, and a long curved neck. Their slimy [[Color/Legends|gray-brown]] hides had two lines of green, pulsing [[Bioluminescence/Legends|bioluminescent]] spots that began behind their bulbous [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and progressed down either side of their [[Skeleton/Legends|spines]]. The [[Diet/Legends|diet]] of the herbivorous species consisted of the many varieties of [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] on Nyriaan, which they grazed upon as they roamed.<ref name="GoI" />

==Behavior==
As herd animals, lluma lived in groups that usually consisted of twenty individuals, with larger herds of up to two hundred in the equatorial regions of Nyriaan. They were [[Reproduction/Legends|hermaphroditic]] creatures that became different [[Gender/Legends|genders]] depending on the herd's composition and the season. A herd was typically around 80% neutral individuals, about 20% fertile female cows, and one male bull; larger herds sometimes had multiple bulls. The cows continually mated with the bull, then carried their fertilized [[Ovum|eggs]] in large pouches until they hatched. Neutral lluma seemed to fulfill a protective role by surrounding cows and bulls while the herd traveled.<ref name="GoI" />

Nyriaan was subjected to violent storms and lluma herds seemed to travel based on the paths of prior tempests, sometimes changing directions when their route intersected the path of another tempest. Their apparent navigational methods drew the interest of [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] and other [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who researched lluma behavior in the hopes of predicting future storms.<ref name="GoI" />

Lluma were sometimes preyed upon by [[chlovi cat]]s, the top predator in the Nyriaan food-chain. They were also considered a staple [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] among various groups of colonists and settlers who considered them delicious, resulting in some of the smaller lluma herds being hunted to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="GoI" />
